scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana
other_conditions: Both spouses must be Indian citizens
One spouse must belong to the Scheduled Caste and the other must be Non‑Scheduled Caste
Beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Beneficiary must not have received benefits under a similar scheme
Application must be made within 3 years of the date of marriage
Benefit applies only to the first marriage
Bride must be at least 18 years old and groom must be at least 21 years old
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,50,000 to the couple, split equally with ₹1,25,000 transferred immediately and ₹1,25,000 locked in a fixed deposit for 3 years.
